name: uncertain-booking-reconciliation
title: Uncertain Booking Reconciliation
summary: Resolve a booking whose outcome is unknown by looking up the original idempotency key, never minting a second key and never re-booking.
when_to_use: The workflow is in BOOKING_UNVERIFIED after a booking attempt whose outcome is unknown
A create_booking attempt returned timeout_before_commit, timeout_after_commit, malformed_response or rate_limited
A reconciliation is still pending and another lookup against the original key is due
A patient or operator asks whether an unverified booking went through

inputs.name: booking_attempt
inputs.description: The original attempt with its idempotency_key, result, http_status and raw_response_ref. The key is the only identifier used for lookups.

inputs.name: workflow_id
inputs.description: The workflow the unresolved booking belongs to.

inputs.name: slot_id
inputs.description: The slot the original attempt was for. Context only: it is not evidence about whether the write landed.

outputs.name: reconciliation
outputs.description: pending, resolved_booked, resolved_not_booked or escalated, with lookup_attempts and escalation_reason.

outputs.name: lookup_evidence
outputs.description: What was asked and what came back, recorded so the resolution is reproducible.

outputs.name: patient_message
outputs.description: States that the outcome is being checked. Never asserts either outcome while unresolved.

outputs.name: decision
outputs.description: Reason code is booking_outcome_unknown while unresolved, ok once resolved, deadline_exceeded when the budget is spent.

references.purpose: Every BookingAttempt result and lookup outcome mapped to a resolution or an escalation, with the key rule stated once.
